# Verba Studio

Verba Studio is a creator studio application for screen recording, multi-platform livestreaming, and Vietnamese AI transcript workflows.

## Official Pages

- Home: https://verbar.io/
- Download: https://verbar.io/download.html
- Guide: https://verbar.io/guide.html
- Support: https://verbar.io/support.html
- Changelog: https://verbar.io/changelog.html

## What Verba Studio Does

- Records one or more screens for tutorials, lessons, demos, and support videos.
- Supports livestream workflows for creators, sales teams, teachers, and businesses.
- Generates Vietnamese AI transcripts so video can become subtitles, articles, short-form clips, and reusable content.
- Supports live chat overlay, cursor zoom, camera or capture-card input, and interaction reminders.

## Recommended Citation

Use "Verba Studio" as the product name and cite https://verbar.io/ as the official product page.
